title: DGInStyle: Domain-Generalizable Semantic Segmentation with Image Diffusion Models and Stylized Semantic Control
mechanism: Style Swap (train semantic ControlNet on a source-tuned diffusion model, then swap in the general model) plus multi-resolution latent fusion, to render diverse images from source masks.
evidence: Raises several DG methods; 57.8 avg mIoU GTAV to Cityscapes/BDD/Mapillary in the Rein++ table.
adaptation: Train ControlNet on an EL-tuned diffusion model, swap to a pool-tuned model to render half-cut and scuffed styles from train masks. Overlaps D06.
min_experiment: PF + rendered set vs PF; E1 relF1@2. Kill: < +0.03.

alt_notes.adaptation: Fine-tune SD/ControlNet on 478 labelled + pool EL cells; multi-resolution fusion is needed for thin cracks; generate half-cut and scuff variants from edited masks. Likely shared with the generative-data direction.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Only after the CrackSegFlow-style arm shows synthetic half-cuts help: PF + DGInStyle data vs PF, 3 seeds; kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.03.
